Problem Statement
Read a line of text using a BufferedReader wrapped over an InputStreamReader, and count the number of non-space characters in it.
Description
Use BufferedReader and InputStreamReader, Java I/O stream classes, to read a single line from standard input. Count the number of characters in the line excluding space characters, and print that count.
Input Description
A single line containing a string, str (may contain spaces).
Output Description
Print the count of non-space characters in str.
